title: Blasting/Explosives Permit
name: Blasting/Explosives Permit
description: Specialist permit for blasting or explosives work. Use only where the activity is authorised by the project explosives arrangements and undertaken by suitably competent, appointed personnel.

fields.label: Explosives Licence / Certificate / Storage Reference (as applicable)
RAMS / Safe System of Work Reference
Explosive and Detonator Types / Planned Quantity

sections.title: AUTHORISATION, INFORMATION AND BLAST DESIGN
items: The blast is covered by the project explosives management arrangements and required legal permissions
A suitably competent shotfirer / person in charge has been formally appointed
The current blasting specification / blast plan is available and understood
Borehole, face, geological and nearby asset information has been checked where relevant
Risks to people, structures, services, roads and neighbouring operations have been assessed
Weather and conditions that could affect safe explosives handling or firing have been assessed

fields.label: Vibration / Air Overpressure / Seismograph Monitoring Plan (if required)

sections.title: EXPLOSIVES RECEIPT, STORAGE AND CHARGING
items: Explosives and detonators will be received, transported, stored and issued under the approved explosives arrangements
Explosives inventory and quantities issued to the blast will be recorded
Explosives and detonators will be protected from unauthorised access, damage and incompatible storage
Only authorised personnel will handle or charge explosives
The charging sequence and hole identification match the current blast specification
Ignition sources, radio-frequency controls and other restrictions specified by the blast plan are in place

fields.label: Magazine / Temporary Storage / Issue Record Reference

sections.title: EXCLUSION ZONE, SECURITY AND WARNING SYSTEM
items: The blast danger / exclusion zone has been defined from the blast specification and site conditions
Access points, roads and work areas affected by the blast will be controlled
Sentries / guards are positioned where required and understand their duties
All persons will be accounted for and cleared from the danger zone before firing
Warning and all-clear signals are agreed, distinguishable and briefed
Vehicle and plant movements into the blast area are prevented during the controlled period

fields.label: Blast Exclusion / Danger Zone and Boundaries
Warning, Firing and All-clear Signal Sequence

sections.title: FIRING, MISFIRE AND EMERGENCY CONTROLS
items: The firing system has been checked in accordance with the approved blast procedure
Final clearance will be confirmed immediately before firing
The shotfirer retains control of the firing decision and firing device
A site-specific misfire procedure is available and understood
No person will re-enter after a suspected misfire until authorised under the misfire procedure
Emergency contacts and arrangements for fire, injury, flyrock or unintended detonation are available

sections.title: POST-BLAST INSPECTION AND AREA RELEASE
items: The shotfirer will inspect the blast area before the all-clear is given
The inspection will check for misfires, unexploded explosives, unstable ground and flyrock hazards
Post-blast fumes and visibility will be assessed before people are allowed to re-enter
Damage or unexpected effects to nearby structures, services or plant will be checked where relevant
Unused explosives, detonators and explosive-contaminated items will be accounted for and returned or disposed of by an authorised method
The blast area will remain controlled until the shotfirer formally releases it

fields.label: Re-entry / Fume Clearance Criteria and Time
Explosives and Detonators Accounted For / Returned
Area Released / All-clear Date and Time

sections.title: HAND-BACK AND CLOSE-OUT
items: The blast is complete and the area has been formally released
Any misfire, damage, unusual event or deviation has been recorded and escalated
Explosives records and monitoring results have been completed
Outstanding restrictions have been communicated to the person receiving the area
